title: The tensor category for W(2,2)-vertex algebra
summary: This paper studies the category $\mathcal{C}$ of grading-restricted $C_1$-cofinite generalized modules for the vertex operator algebra associated to the $W$-algebra $W(2,2)$. We first show that $\mathcal{C}$ is the same as the category of finite length modules whose simple composition factors are the irreducible highest weight $W(2,2)$--modules $L[r]$ of highest weight $(\frac{1-r}{2}, 0)$ for $r \in \mathbb{Z}_{> 0}$, and hence $\mathcal{C}$ carries a braided tensor category structure.
